lines.say: How long should you really rest between sets?
Short rests feel like hard work. You're sweaty and out of breath. But that's not the same as growth.
In one study, trained men rested either one minute, or three minutes, for eight weeks.
The three minute group did more reps in every set, and gained more strength and more muscle.
Rest too short, and your next set is weaker. Fewer good reps, less growth signal.
So rest long enough to hit your reps again. About two to three minutes for big lifts, a bit less for small ones.
